state.project: GTC: South Hazlehurst - New Lacy 230kV Line
state.description: GTC will build a new 230kV transmission line between South Hazlehurst (bus 2) and New Lacy substation (approximately 25 miles) with 100C ACSR 1351 Martin conductor. Do all the necessary upgrade work to accommodate the additional line in both facilities.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?

criteria.true: Same facility: the name matches and the operator, voltage and area are consistent with the project.
criteria.false: A different facility, e.g. a similarly named substation of another utility or in the wrong area.
